{{Short description|Dutch theoretical chemist}}
'''Evert Jan Baerends''' (born 17 September 1945) is a Dutch theoretical chemist. He is an emeritus professor of the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]]. Baerends is known for his development and application of electronic structure calculations, which over time led to the development of the [[Amsterdam Density Functional]].<ref name=iaqms>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.iaqms.org/members/baerends.php |title=Evert-Jan Baerends |publisher=International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science |date= |accessdate=19 November 2015}}</ref><ref name=scm>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.scm.com/About/AboutManagement.html |title=The SCM Board of Directors |publisher=Scientific Computing & Modeling |date= |accessdate=19 November 2015}}</ref> He worked extensively on [[density functional theory]].

==Career==
Baerends was born on 17 September 1945 in [[Voorst]].<ref name=iaqms/> He obtained his PhD at the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]] under professor Pieter Ros.<ref name="iqcc">{{cite web|author= |url=http://iqcc.udg.edu/wordpress/2019/05/16/prof-evert-jan-baerends-doctor-honoris-causa/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201009200223/http://iqcc.udg.edu/wordpress/2019/05/16/prof-evert-jan-baerends-doctor-honoris-causa/ |title=Prof. Evert Jan Baerends, Doctor Honoris Causa |publisher=Institut de Química Computacional i Catàlisi |date=16 May 2019 |archive-date=9 October 2020}}</ref> Baerends became a professor of Theoretical chemistry at the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. He did extensive research on [[density functional theory]] and was involved in the development and application of electronic structure calculations, which later led to the development of the [[Amsterdam Density Functional]].<ref name=iaqms/> 

Baerends became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web |author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/6081?set_language=en |title=Jan Baerends |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |accessdate=19 November 2015 |archive-date=20 November 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151120071650/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/6081?set_language=en |url-status=dead }}</ref>
In 2010 he was awarded the [[Schrödinger Medal]] by the [[World Association of Theoretical and Computational Chemists]], being noted for: "For his pioneering contributions to the development of computational density functional methods and his fundamental contributions to density functional theory and density matrix theory."<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://watoc.net/watoc.schroedinger.html |title=Schrödinger Medal |publisher=World Association of Theoretical and Computational Chemists |date= |accessdate=19 November 2015}}</ref> Baerends is a member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]].<ref name=iaqms/>

After his retirement in the Netherlands Baerends lectured at [[Pohang University of Science and Technology]] in South Korea.<ref name=scm/> In 2019 he received an honorary doctorate from the [[University of Girona]].<ref name="iqcc"/>
